_about: Trips in Cheddar's car (see CarTrip, Beach, DriveView). The car unlocks with his invite scene (data/scenes.json, cheddar_car_invite: when he first reaches min_stage), which adds 'unlock' to the restaurant's unlocks. After that it's parked out front after hours; while he's at min_stage or more he waits by it, and any chef can start a trip. The other chefs are asked if they're coming (each once they're out of any close-up or dialogue), and the trip waits for every answer. The drive is one shared view with Cheddar chatting (chatter_lines of his car_chatter lines); after skip_after_trips trips to the beach it can be skipped. What Cheddar says is in his character file: car_greeting, car_ask, car_chatter, car_arrive, car_home, beach_chat, and car_note (the note on the car while he's below min_stage). Positions are [x, z]: parked_at in the world, the beach ones from the beach's origin.

drive._sky: The sky behind the drive for each hour block (data/time.json).
